turns.content: Big life update: I took a staff data engineer role at a startup called Northwind Grid and relocated to Denver two weeks ago.
That's a big change, congratulations. How was leaving Meridian Labs?
Bittersweet. Priya tried to counter but the Denver offer was too good. Biscuit loves the trails here already.
And the half marathon plans, still on?
Switched my registration to the Denver half in September instead. Nora is still coming. Also started learning Rust for the new job, we do a lot of systems work.
